scope: Source-derived field candidates only, NOT actual live schema or verified semantic mapping

rows.sourceDefinition: BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT 'lms_group of kind ELECTIVE; its ACTIVE members are the enrolled learners'
INT NOT NULL COMMENT 'The GROUP_BACKED class all content/timetable/attendance is keyed on'
INT NULL COMMENT 'Mirrors lms_group.capacity for display; the group enforces it'
VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' COMMENT 'ACTIVE | ARCHIVED'
DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' AND (is_deleted = false OR is_deleted IS NULL) THEN course_id ELSE NULL END) VIRTUAL
INT NOT NULL COMMENT 'The curriculum this slot belongs to; allocation may still take learners from any program in the college'
VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g. Professional Elective 1'
INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT 'How many offerings of this slot one learner may hold; enforced by ElectiveJoinPolicy'
VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' COMMENT 'ACTIVE | ARCHIVED'
DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Feature-owned discriminator, e.g. ELECTIVE, CRT, BUS. Upper-case identifier; the kernel stores it, never interprets it'
VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'COLLEGE' COMMENT 'COLLEGE | PLATFORM'
INT NULL COMMENT 'NULL only for PLATFORM-owned groups (super-admin)'
VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' COMMENT 'DRAFT | ACTIVE | CLOSED | ARCHIVED. Self-join needs ACTIVE; admins may build a roster in DRAFT'
INT NULL COMMENT 'NULL = unlimited. Hard limit on ACTIVE members, enforced by the atomic seat claim'
INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Denormalised count of ACTIVE members. Seat claim = UPDATE ... WHERE active_count < capacity; reconcile endpoint recomputes it'
DATETIME NULL COMMENT 'Learners may join themselves only inside [from, until]; NULL from = self-join disabled'
JSON NULL COMMENT 'Feature-owned settings, stored and returned opaquely. Kernel reads only allowWaitlist and allowSelfLeave'
DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LEARNER' COMMENT 'LEARNER today; FACULTY/EXTERNAL reserved'
VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'REQUESTED | ACTIVE | WAITLISTED | REMOVED'
VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'MANUAL | CSV | RULE | SELF'
BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT 'An explicit admin decision: a rule re-run never overturns it, and a locked REMOVED row blocks self re-join'
DATETIME NULL COMMENT 'When the member last became ACTIVE'
DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT 'LEARNER | FACULTY | SUPER_ADMIN | SYSTEM'
JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Same shape as job.eligibility_json (JobEligibility.java): branches, minCgpa, maxActiveBacklogs, passingYears, ... One evaluator serves both'
BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT 'Reserved for a scheduled re-run; V1 applies on demand'
DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
